name: How long does professional blood cleanup on carpet usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does professional blood cleanup on carpet usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of professional blood cleanup on carpet can vary significantly depending on the size and severity of the spill. A small, contained spill might take a few hours to complete, including cleaning, disinfection, and drying. However, larger or more complex situations where blood has penetrated deeply into the carpet, padding, or subfloor, or where multiple areas are affected, could extend the process to a full day or even longer. Factors like drying times for cleaning agents and potential structural material replacement also influence the total time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleanup time varies based on spill size and severity, from a few hours for small stains to a full day or more for larger, more complex contaminations.
